threads.body:
@copilot Reduce the testing added by this PR to basic integration coverage of the new terminal protocol error classification. This is a test-scope reduction, not a request to change production behavior.

Keep SpymemcachedTest.storeRejectedAsTooLarge(), including an agent-backed execution with spymemcached 2.12.3 where future.get() returns false and the span reports ERROR with error.type=ERR_2BIG. Keep the matching db.client.operation.duration error.type assertion in that same test. The 2.12.0 execution throws OperationException and alone does not demonstrate the newly detected response-level failure.

Narrow the newly added protocolStatusTest suite to this regression instead of rerunning the entire SpymemcachedTest class. Preserve the baseline and existing latest-dependency coverage, correct testLatestDeps propagation, and existing experimental coverage. Remove the getter-unit-test matrix added by this PR from SpymemcachedAttributesGetterTest, and remove the new conditionalOutcomesAreSuccessful() matrix. Leave pre-existing success, miss, cancellation, and CAS tests intact. Remove new exception-signal executions introduced solely to repeat this regression; do not delete pre-existing suites.

Preserve exact emitted-telemetry assertions and the production fix. Remove imports, helpers, dependencies, or test wiring made unused by these deletions. Use the repository's narrow formatting and relevant validation commands, without adding test permutations or unrelated fixes. Keep this deliverable scoped to this existing PR and preserve its draft/ready state. Update the PR description only where the reduced coverage makes it stale, while preserving its repository template. Report exactly what was retained and removed.

replies.body: Implemented in `f0a11f1a`. Retained `storeRejectedAsTooLarge()` with exact ERROR/`ERR_2BIG` span and duration-metric assertions on the agent-backed 2.12.3 client, plus baseline and existing experimental coverage and `testLatestDeps` propagation. Filtered `protocolStatusTest` to that regression. Removed the getter unit-test matrix, conditional-outcomes matrix, added miss/cancellation/CAS assertions, and the new exception-signal execution. Production behavior and pre-existing suites remain unchanged.
